description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): 1 2312A23D; 2 0512A05D; 3 23AD; 4 05AD; 5 12AD; 6 30AD. The first two use both runways: 2312A23D lands on 23 and 12 and departs from 23; 0512A05D lands on 05 and 12 and departs from 05. No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.
